description.zh: 音频场景组件包：频谱引擎图、波形包络图、钢琴卷帘图——音频/编曲教学的可视化视图
description.en: docvi audio-scenario component pack: spectrum, waveform and piano-roll teaching diagrams (static SVG)

description.zh: 频域频谱教学图：各 bin 均匀排布的声柱 + 对数频率刻度 + 选中频段覆盖层与峰值保持线（静态 SVG，0..1 电平）
description.en: Frequency-domain teaching chart: evenly spaced bin bars + log frequency scale + selected band overlay and peak-hold line (static SVG, 0..1 levels)

description.zh: 时域波形教学图：对称柱状峰值包络 + 中轴线 + 可选时间刻度与播放头（静态 SVG）
description.en: Time-domain teaching chart: symmetric bar peak envelope + center axis + optional time ticks and playhead (static SVG)

description.zh: 音符卷帘教学图：纵轴音高（白/黑键行 + 音名）、横轴为拍，每个音符一条矩形（velocity 决定不透明度）
description.en: Note roll teaching chart: vertical pitch axis (white/black key rows + note names), horizontal beats, one rect per note (velocity → opacity)
